selection.basis: The research queue has three Quick Pro ER:ONE evidence-found ledger fields whose accepted sources and exact-model facts already appear in the candidate. A source-reuse resolution can clear each ledger item without new searches or fabricated attempts, while preserving source caveats and all unrelated open requirements.

fields.recorded_fact: 7100 g; manufacturer claim 7.1 kg ±5% for the carbon-spoke Ultegra Di2 build; size and selected RORE wheel model unspecified
CNY 33,900 reference conversion from US$4,999 using the 2026-07-31 rate; not a mainland checkout price
Qualitative owner-reported power response and perceived stiffness; wheels contribute; no numeric or instrumented frame-isolation result

research_route.action: Read-only audit of the exact candidate, the three accepted source records, and their research attempts. Add resolution.kind=source-reuse only where each accepted source directly supports a fact already recorded for that target and the limitation is retained in the resolution note. Do not browse, add a source, edit catalog facts, or reuse a related trim.
research_route.acceptance_rule: A ledger field may be source-reuse-resolved only when the candidate already records the matching fact and its caveat, and the resolution.source_ids are already accepted for that attempt. The numeric-stiffness gap and mainland checkout/delivery/warranty gaps stay open.
research_route.stop_rule: One exact model and three fields only. If any source-to-fact match is ambiguous, leave that field unresolved and report why.

done_criteria: Return one bounded read-only evidence audit for the three exact-model fields.
Integrate only justified source-reuse resolutions, then run npm run validate, npm run research:check, and npm run coverage:check.
Do not rerun npm run check for this research-metadata-only change; no catalog, source, or code facts are changed.
Local B84 only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
